system.description:
Originally a secret of the Indian warriors of the Kshatriya jati, used in their ceaseless battles against the asuratizayya demons, knowledge of this power came to Europe with the first Ravnos who arrived in pre-Roman times. The Ravnos summons a weapon of tenuous physical substance that appears as a normal blade to others, yet can inflict grievous injuries while it exists.

System: The player spends two Willpower points, plus one blood point per damage die the weapon inflicts over its base Strength damage (e.g. a Horrid Knife costs one blood point for Strength + 1 damage). An additional die of damage may be purchased for an additional blood point. The weapon appears in the Ravnos' hand the moment she activates the power and remains for a full scene; if disarmed, she may summon it back to her hand by spending another blood point. The Horrid Blade inflicts aggravated damage and, unlike Horrid Reality's effects, does not fade once the power ends.

Costs 20 Experience Traits to learn.

MET: Spend two Willpower Traits and one Blood Trait per additional die of aggravated damage desired above the wielder's base Strength; a Chimerstry weapon of tenuous but genuine substance appears in hand for the remainder of the scene and deals real, permanent aggravated damage.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book One: Charlatans
